title: normalize_nps_roads: drop whitespace-only passthrough values instead of emitting blank attributes
check: cd lib && python3 -c "import normalize_nps_roads as n; r=type('R',(),{'add':lambda *a,**k:None})(); p=n.normalize({'properties':{'geometryid':'1','rdsurface':'   ','rdname':' '}},r); assert 'surface' not in p and 'name' not in p, p" && python3 -m unittest -v
dod: WHEN a feature's passthrough column (e.g. RDSURFACE, RDNAME) holds only whitespace THE NORMALIZER SHALL omit the attribute instead of emitting a blank value
WHEN the lib unit suite runs THE SUITE SHALL exit 0 with at least one new test covering the whitespace case in lib/test_normalize_nps_roads.py
WHEN the change is diffed THE DIFF SHALL touch only lib/normalize_nps_roads.py and lib/test_normalize_nps_roads.py
